title: Jordan decomposition of a locally bounded functional on C_c(X, ℝ)
statement: Let X be a topological space and let Λ : C_c(X, ℝ) → ℝ be a real linear map that is locally bounded: for every compact K ⊆ X there is M ∈ ℝ with |Λ f| ≤ M for all f ∈ C_c(X, ℝ) with tsupport f ⊆ K and |f(x)| ≤ 1 for all x. Then there are positive linear functionals Λ₁, Λ₂ on C_c(X, ℝ), that is, elements of C_c(X, ℝ) →ₚ[ℝ] ℝ (ℝ-linear and order-preserving), such that Λ f = Λ₁ f − Λ₂ f for every f ∈ C_c(X, ℝ).
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] (Λ : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ), (∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ, tsupport f ⊆ K → (∀ x, |f x| ≤ 1) → |Λ f| ≤ M) → ∃ Λ₁ Λ₂ : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ →ₚ[ℝ] ℝ, ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ, Λ f = Λ₁ f - Λ₂ f
